nodes.label: Synapse AI Platform
nodes.rationale: Open-source multi-agent orchestration platform. Wires agents, tools, and LLMs into deterministic DAG pipelines without framework lock-in.

nodes.label: Deterministic DAG Execution
nodes.rationale: Orchestrations follow the exact path designed — no hallucinated detours. Core design tenet.

nodes.label: Multi-Model Orchestration
nodes.rationale: Different LLM per step: fast/cheap for routing, powerful for analysis. User controls where compute goes.

nodes.label: Local-First, No Lock-In
nodes.rationale: Full local operation with Ollama. Mix local and cloud freely. User data stays with the user.

nodes.label: Scale Mode (distributed)
nodes.rationale: Redis Cluster + ARQ worker fleet + PgBouncer + S3 artifacts. Multi-tenant quotas with HTTP 429. Per-step checkpoint recovery.

nodes.label: Human-in-the-Loop
nodes.rationale: Pause workflows for human review. Resumable across restarts. UI, Slack, Telegram, or any messaging channel.

nodes.label: Turn Anything Into a Tool
nodes.rationale: Python scripts, REST APIs, webhooks, MCP servers, or entire orchestrations — all become agent-callable tools.

nodes.label: 14+ LLM Providers
nodes.rationale: Cloud, local, and CLI providers: Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, xAI, DeepSeek, AWS Bedrock, and more.

nodes.label: Built-In Scheduling & Messaging
nodes.rationale: Cron automation with results pushed to Slack, Discord, Telegram, Teams, or WhatsApp.

nodes.label: ReAct Agent Loop
nodes.rationale: LLM call → tool parse → observation → iterate. Backbone of single-agent execution in backend/core/react_engine.py.

nodes.label: MCP Session Manager
nodes.rationale: stdio + remote Streamable HTTP/SSE with OAuth 2.0 PKCE + Bearer auto-refresh. Aggregates external tool servers into the agent.

nodes.label: Orchestration Canvas (ReactFlow)
nodes.rationale: Visual drag-and-drop DAG editor in the Next.js frontend. Users assemble multi-step workflows without code.

nodes.label: Vault (auto-saves large outputs)
nodes.rationale: Auto-saves large tool outputs to disk; resolves @[path] mentions inline. Avoids blowing up LLM context on big payloads.

nodes.label: Semantic Cross-Session Memory (ChromaDB)
nodes.rationale: Vector store lets agents recall relevant facts across sessions without stuffing history into every prompt.

nodes.label: Usage & Cost Tracker
nodes.rationale: Token + cost tracking priced via data/model_pricing.json. Per-run visibility into spend.

nodes.label: Redis Job Queue + SSE Streams
nodes.rationale: Cluster mode: job queue, SSE event streams, pub/sub cancellation, auto-failover.

nodes.label: ARQ Worker Fleet
nodes.rationale: 1 to 100+ workers, each up to 20 concurrent orchestrations. Autoscale with KEDA on queue depth.

nodes.label: PgBouncer Connection Pool
nodes.rationale: Multiplexes hundreds of worker connections into a small stable Postgres pool — prevents connection storms.

nodes.label: S3 Artifact Storage
nodes.rationale: Streams large file outputs to AWS S3 / Cloudflare R2 / MinIO instead of round-tripping through Postgres.

nodes.label: Multi-Tenant Quotas (HTTP 429)
nodes.rationale: Per-team/customer concurrent-run limits with HTTP 429 enforcement.

nodes.label: Per-Step Checkpoint Recovery
nodes.rationale: Worker crashes don't lose jobs; the next worker resumes from the last completed step.

nodes.label: docker-compose: backend service
nodes.rationale: FastAPI container. Waits 90s for MCP servers before health check flips green — otherwise the frontend's service_healthy dep aborts.

nodes.label: docker-compose: redis (scale profile)
nodes.rationale: Only started with --profile scale. Appendonly, 2GB maxmemory, allkeys-lru eviction.

nodes.label: KEDA ScaledObject (queue-depth autoscale)
nodes.rationale: Autoscales worker replicas based on Redis queue depth — the scale-mode primitive the README calls out.

nodes.label: GitHub Actions: CI Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Fast test gate — runs the same 'python -m pytest' the backend/tests/README calls the deploy gate.

nodes.label: GitHub Actions: Nightly Integration
nodes.rationale: Real Redis + Postgres run for V2 end-to-end and the excluded coverage modules (scale/worker, messaging, mcp_client, scheduler, memory).

nodes.label: Coding-profile extra dependencies
nodes.rationale: Extras loaded when the coding tools profile is active.

nodes.label: Fake LLM fixture (scriptable, no keys)
nodes.rationale: Autouse pytest fixture replaces generate_response at all three binding sites with a scriptable async fake — production ReAct loop runs unchanged, no API keys required in CI.

nodes.label: Deploy Gate (pytest fast suite)
nodes.rationale: 'python -m pytest' from repo root excludes stress + integration; this is what CI enforces as the merge gate with --cov-fail-under.
